description: This PHP class 'LogRecordIterator' enables iteration over log records generated by AWS CloudTrail, providing methods to create iterators from S3 buckets, files, or trail options, and handling the reading of compressed JSON log data.

classes.name: LogRecordIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for AWS CloudTrail log records, allowing iteration over log entries across multiple log files in S3 buckets or individual files.

methods.name: forTrail
methods.description: Factory method to create a LogRecordIterator for a CloudTrail trail, given S3 and CloudTrail clients and options.

methods.name: forBucket
methods.description: Factory method to create a LogRecordIterator for a specific S3 bucket with optional parameters.

methods.name: forFile
methods.description: Factory method to create a LogRecordIterator for a specific S3 object (log file).

methods.name: loadRecordsFromCurrentLogFile
methods.description: Internal method to load log records from the current log file pointed to by the iterator.
